content:
# ACK S3 Logs Bucket Configuration

Below are the four new manifest files required to add the logs bucket to dev and prod environments. These are independent additions—no changes are needed to existing files.

**Note:** The policy resources reference `userName: myapp-dev` and `roleName: myapp-prod`. Adjust these to match the actual User/Role names in your existing `iam.yaml` files if they differ.

---

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: UserPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  userName: myapp-dev
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  roleName: myapp-prod
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

## Deployment

Apply these manifests to your respective clusters:

```bash
kubectl apply -f dev/logs-bucket.yaml -f dev/logs-policy.yaml      # dev
kubectl apply -f prod/logs-bucket.yaml -f prod/logs-policy.yaml    # prod
```

Each environment is independent; changes to one do not affect the other. The policies grant only `s3:GetObject` and `s3:PutObject` on the logs buckets and do not modify access to the existing assets buckets.
